A 7.5m / 25ft configuration with wrist strap is shown. Buyers should confirm the final blade width, scale system, case color, logo and packaging direction before the sample is approved.
Send the required quantity, market, logo and packaging reference for a focused quotation. This makes it possible to verify the selected configuration and quality checkpoints before bulk delivery.
